name: maison-blush
description: Maison Blush – salon website (React frontend + Express backend + chatbot)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
